item.title: How to Send Messages to OpenClaw Remotely
item.description: 1. Configure hooks Configure hooks in openclaw.json 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 "hooks": { "enabled": true, "token": "xxx", "path": "/openclaw/hooks", "allowRequestSessionKey": true, "allowedAgentIds": ["*"] }, See https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/webhook The token here must not be the same as the gateway’s token. 2.
